The supplied FPGA binary incorporates the official RedPitaya/RedPitaya-FPGA
board and processing-system support at commit
728a4f37e9c0a9b5ba1d9b7a0d44c38bbd2dc674. Its BSD notice is reproduced in
RedPitaya-FPGA-LICENSE. The build fetches that source separately and preserves
its original file notices. AMD tools and installation credentials are not
redistributed. This notice does not assign a new license to the custom code
or the optional Airy-SLAM integration.
